# Generator features

<!-- Generated by `comline-conformance` (`support_is_proven`) - don't edit by hand. Regenerate with `CONFORMANCE_BLESS=1 cargo test`. -->

What the typescript generator implements, and the conformance fixtures that prove it. A claim is checked, not trusted: a supported feature has a fixture that generates and matches its golden, an ignored one generates exactly what it would without the feature, and an unsupported one is refused with an error naming every use.
